other_failure_modes.name: In-sample Stacking Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains a secondary model (or residual corrector) using the in-sample training predictions of the first model. Because the first model overfits its training data, its in-sample residuals do not represent out-of-sample errors, causing the secondary model to learn incorrect patterns and generalise poorly. Out-of-fold predictions should be used instead.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong practices in data cleaning, extensive feature engineering, and proper median imputation after splitting. However, its custom two-stage residual model suffers from severe in-sample stacking leakage, as the second stage is erroneously trained on the first stage's in-sample predictions rather than out-of-fold predictions. Additionally, there is minor leakage in categorical encoding, and the agent only evaluates using a single split and metric.
